, starring and , is an absurd buddy spy comedy about two completely ordinary corporate guys who suddenly find themselves caught in a national-security operation. But can Kunal Kemmu pull off the same magic as Madgaon Express while wearing four hats this time?
In this episode of First Cut, Dabeet Singh reviews and analyses Vibe, breaking down the good, the bad and everything in between, so you can decide whether it's worth watching in theatres.
